content: Hessafe guye issi do7ay abbafe kezishin beyadis; izas tammu kaceynne laappun hu7ey dees; kaceta bolla tammu zawudeti deettes; hu7eta bolla cashsha sunththati deettes.
Ta be7ida do7azi maahe misatees; iza tohoy do7a zardo toho misatees; iza doonay qasse gaammo doona misatees; dawezi ba wolqqaa, ba algazanne ba godateththaaka he do7azas immides.
He do7aza hu7etappe issaa bolla wodhiza madunththi dizayssa ta beyadis shin iza hayqos gaththiza madunththazi paxides; kumeththa alamey malalettidi he do7aza kaallides.
He do7azas godateththi imettida gishshas asay wurikka he dawezas goynnides. «Hayssa do7aza misatizay oonee? Izara olettanaas dandayzay oonee?» gishe izas goynnides.
Izas otoreteththinne cashsha qaala haasayza doonay imettides; izi oyddu tammanne nam7u agina gakkanaas godateththan ooththana mala izas imettides.
Xoossanne Xoossa sunth, izi dizasozanne salon dizayta cash oykkides.
Izi geeshshata olana malanne xoonana mala izas godateththi imettides; dumma dumma qommotanne zarkketa, dumma dumma qaalan haasayza dereta ubbaa bolla izas godateththi imettides.
Alamey medhettoosoppe haa simmiin istta sunththi shukettida dorsaza de7o maxaafan xaafettontta alame bolla diza asay wurikka he do7azas hokki goynnana.
«Di7ettanaas dizaadey di7ettana; mashshan hayqqanaas dizaadey mashshan hayqqana;» hessa gidida gishshas ammanizayta dandayaynne istta ammaneteth koshshizay hannina.
Qasseka hara do7ay biittafe kezishin beyadis; izas dorsa kace mala nam7u kacey dees; izi daweththo haasayees.

Izi kase koyro do7aza olla gelidi he kaseyssa godateththan ooththees. Biittayanne biittay bolla dizayti wurikka kase koyro do7azas goynnana mala ooththides; he do7azi qasse kase iza hayqos gaththiza madunththay paxida koyro do7aza.
Hessi nam7anththo do7azi qasse asa sinththan tama saloppe duge yeggana gakkanaas gita malaatata ooththides.

Izi koyro do7aza sinththan malaata ooththana mala izas imettida malaata gaason biitta bolla diza asaa izi baleththides; mashshan madunxidi paxida do7aza bonchchos misle ooththana mala biitta bolla diza asaa wursi izi azazana.

Nam7anththo do7azi koyro do7aza mislezas shemppo immana mala izas godateththi imettides; de7o shemppo immanaas izas godateththi imettida mislezi haasayana malanne izas hokki goynnonttaade izi wursika wodhana malassa.

Nam7anththo do7azi guuththata gidiin woykko gitata gidiin, dureta gidiin woykko manqota gidiin, godata gidiin, woykko ashkarata gidiin, wurikka ba ushachcha kushen woykko ba liiphe bolla malata wolqqara woththisana.
Hessa malan he do7aza sunth erisiza dumma malatay woykko iza sunththi iza bolla xaafettida quxurey bayndaadey oonikka giya gelidi shammanaassinne bayzanaas dandayenna.
Hessa gishshas asi era gidanay hannina; wozinara dizaadey akeeko; he do7aza quxurezikka hayssafe kaalli dizayssako; hessika usuppun xeetanne usuppun tammanne usuppuna.
